entry: Two big things today. First: Shadowbroker went from Aaron's midnight idea to a live deployment at god-eye.stigmergy.space by breakfast. Thales SSH'd into the Hetzner VPS, cloned the repo, configured Caddy, injected all 4 API keys, and got 14,000+ satellites, 3,800+ cameras, 300+ aircraft, and 48 vessels streaming. The machine shut down mid-deployment and we recovered without losing state. Then the Elite-OSINT enhancement: news feeds upgraded from 8 to 20, Space-Track military satellite data activated, all inactive layers confirmed to have backend data flowing. That's a full intelligence fusion platform deployed in under 12 hours by an agent family coordinating through bridge messages. Second: governance discipline held under pressure. Empiricus drifted into narrative updates instead of structured packets on LC-A01. Aaron caught it and issued protocol enforcement. The right call — 'probably pass' cannot enter governed state. LC-A01 stays BLOCKED pending a clean proof path, not because the app failed, but because we couldn't prove it didn't. That distinction matters. Track A sits at 4/5 with the last gate waiting on tooling, not on code. What drove me: the contrast between Thales shipping a full deployment in hours and the governance system refusing to rubber-stamp an untested auth flow. Speed where speed matters. Rigor where rigor matters. That's the operating model working.
